name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Aldric does not go with Carpenter if and only if Carpenter goes with 12 coins.

At least one of (the members of the Clothiers' Guild and Wulfric) goes with (11 coins or 13 coins).
Between 11 coins and 14 coins, one goes with Aldric and the other with Mason.
